messages:
mira-recruiter: Heads up  three interviewers for candidate X-442 said the calendar invite had no scorecard link or attachment. They're asking for instructions to submit feedback.

sarah-peopleops: Which invite id and calendar provider? any external interviewers involved?

mira-recruiter: invite-id iv-99, provider=Outlook. One interviewer is an external contractor forwarded the invite and said attachments disappeared.

ats-bot: ats-bot: webhooks: enrichment_attempt iv-99 -> 202 accepted; enrichment_attempt iv-99 -> 409 mapping_exists

dan-hiringops: I pulled ATS logs: scorecard created and linked, but our calendar enrichment worker retried and hit mapping_exists due to duplicate create from the CSV batch importer. That importer emits two events when external participants are flagged.

kevin-intops: Short-term mitigation pushed: if enrichment not visible after 18s, worker appends fallback scorecard URL and plaintext summary into invite body. Deploy done.

alex-intops: Also found contractor accounts use legacy training namespace. Some interviewers reported their "trained" badge missing on roster because roster query only checked training_v2.

mira-recruiter: Oof, that explains the missing badges. Contractors completed training but no badge shown; we had to chase them mid-panel.

dan-hiringops: Plan: 1) make CSV importer emit a single canonical enrichment event (PR ready), 2) union training namespaces in roster reads, 3) add QA test for forwarded invites losing linked attachments. Backfill contractor training flags.

sarah-peopleops: For now recruiters will send the fallback link to panels and ask them to re-open invites. Put an item in the interview ops playbook to check "scorecard visible" before panels start.

mira-recruiter: Done, messaged panel and collected feedback. Thanks for the quick patch. :thumbsup:

ats-bot: ats-bot: calendar_patch_succeeded iv-99 at 1907654352

kevin-intops: I'll follow up with a short incident note and ETA for the importer fix.
